name: Do I need a separate rental agreement in addition to the home sale contract?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a separate rental agreement in addition to the home sale contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you absolutely need a separate, detailed rental agreement or lease to accompany the home sale contract in a sale-leaseback or post-occupancy scenario. The sale contract covers the transfer of ownership, while the rental agreement explicitly outlines your rights and responsibilities as a tenant, including rent amount, lease term, maintenance duties, and security deposit. This clear distinction prevents ambiguities and protects both parties, and our team ensures both documents are thoroughly prepared and coordinated.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a separate rental agreement is essential alongside the home sale contract to define tenant rights, responsibilities, and lease terms, ensuring clarity for both parties.
